newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buyers hold back pending USDA.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buyers hold back pending USDA.

text.p: Attention on Friday centred on the announcement by the U.S.Department of Agriculture of its revised assessment of world and U.S. supply and demand prospects for 1997/98, traders said.
Changes on the month overall proved to be relatively minor, though the Department's forecast of U.S. production was cut by 500,000 statistical bales.
A reduction was in fact anticipated since Washington recently lowered its estimate of the area sown.

Pending the release of the figures many buyers remained on the sidelines. However, demand was sustained from such markets as Brazil. In Europe, buyers price ideas were generally well below sellers' asking rates.
